summary: v_div_fmas_f64 with VCC = 0 is a binary64 fma with one rounding: fma(a, a, c) = 2^-60 for a = 1 + 2^-30, c = -(1 + 2^-29), operands as literals

known.when: translated to GLSL.std.450 Fma on doubles
known.note: The driver folds the all-constant Fma at pipeline compile time and rounds the product first. Measured on RTX 4090 (621.24), RTX 3070 (621.01), Quadro RTX 4000 (615.71.09); RTX 5060 Laptop (Blackwell) fuses. OpFmaKHR (SPV_KHR_fma) is exact.

provenance: original (the same probe is in ubiquitarianism/leonida runtime/test/shaders/cs_div_fmas_f64.asm, GPL-3.0, by the same author)
